sequence_within_stratum: 10 author requests, then predeclared primary/swapped judges; skip both judges if either author unavailable
primary_outcome: First primary pairwise preference by model and family; all admitted failures retained
secondary_outcomes: raw usage and local elapsed time
literal masking observations and judge condition clues
resource_comparison: Same author model, format, reasoning settings and token/time limits within each pair. Toolkit arm includes extra method instruction tokens; this is not a token-matched cost comparison.
judge_admission: 12-control Astra calibration, source adjudication, four matched defect preferences and four valid ties; dimension drift retained. Single judge only, requested model identity unverified by CLI.
analysis_limits: Five public purposive synthetic families; translations, providers and swaps are not extra families. No formal effect estimate, general superiority, retrieval or Full workflow claim. No outcome-driven append or paid retry.
stopping_rule: Complete each admitted first-attempt queue within its request ceilings; preserve any operational interruption without silent resume. No negative-result retries.
